text:
Ana: heads-up — small set of ap-southeast GPU nodes failing bootstrap after egress audit change. keystore KMS decrypt errors during init.
Chris: seeing similar in eu-west-2, started ~07:12 UTC. warm pools stuck at 0/4 ready.
Mike: paste from node logs:
```
2026-03-20T07:13:02Z ERROR keystore: decrypt failed: AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource
	status code: 403, request id: a1b2c3d4
```
Nana: controllers can't unwrap model keys, models won't load, provisioning backlog increasing. :grimacing:
Sarah: security pushed the egress->logging-proxy change to meet SOC2. We intentionally removed broad NAT to KMS endpoints; traffic must flow via proxy.
Chris: short-term we need nodes to finish bootstrap. Proposal: keystore-service does decrypt on behalf of nodes (nodes talk to keystore via privatelink), keeps proxy and audit intact.
Mike: that avoids opening NAT. Need to ensure keystore-service assumes a role with kms:Decrypt and logs CloudTrail events keyed to node id.
Sarah: acceptable if we meet controls: assumed creds <= 3600s, mTLS between node and keystore-service, and decrypt events include node identity and request id. Compliance will require a GRC ticket.
Chris: IAM policy draft for keystore-service (review):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
    "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:123456789012:key/keystore-main",
    "Condition": {
      "StringEquals": {"aws:SourceVpce": "vpce-0a1b2c3d"}
    }
  }]
}
```
Nana: tying to the VPC endpoint ensures traffic still hits the proxy/privatelink. good.
Mike: rollout plan: 1) implement decrypt-proxy + audit events; 2) create tight role + policy; 3) canary to ap-southeast warm pool (8 nodes); 4) monitor decrypt.success and warmpool.join; rollback if decrypt.fail > 5/min.
Chris: added alert: keystore.decrypt.fail > 5/min -> rollback.
Deploy-bot: Deploy started: patch/keystore-decrypt-proxy -> canary (ap-southeast) by Chris.
Mike: cost note: extra STS calls + CloudTrail ingest, estimate <$250/day during canary.
Sarah: open a GRC ticket; link it here. TTL enforcement and audit linkage required before global rollout. :white_check_mark:
Nana: canary metrics coming in — decrypt success 99.6%, warmpool warming, nodes joining.
Ops-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-3142 
keystore decrypt failures after egress-proxy rollout. Status: mitigated -> monitoring.
Chris: postmortem items: finalize role policy, add runbook step for egress-proxy rollouts, validate privatelink coverage in all regions.
Mike: filing runbook PR and adding playbook snippet for future egress changes.
Nana: thanks all — will close after postmortem link added.
